profile.headline: Engineering & Technical Leadership | Software, Systems & Machine Control | NPI
profile.summary:
With over 20 years of software engineering experience, I focus on new product implementations, systems integration, and technical leadership. My role involves contributing to the development and deployment of advanced inspection instruments, from architecture to customer pilots, by leveraging my expertise in software and machine control.  

Throughout my career, I have consistently bridged the gap between software, hardware, and industrial systems to deliver integrated and functional products. My hands-on approach spans software architecture, mechanical assembly, and system troubleshooting, ensuring smooth product lifecycle execution. My goal is to drive impactful engineering solutions while fostering strong collaboration within teams.
